title: A Smile for the Cellar
author: Jude Dravenmoor
blurb: Cyrus Crane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
